description.value: A group campsite in old-growth Goldstream Park, 16 km from Victoria, set among 600-year-old Douglas firs beside a chum salmon–spawning river with waterfall and ridge trails nearby; flush washrooms and showers on site, but group-minimum pricing applies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a specific group campsite within Goldstream Provincial Park, with the BC Parks website confirming the park is active and reservations are accepted via camping.bcparks.ca. The website mentions a summer-season concession and picnic area with shelters, but provides no details specific to this individual group site. Critically, the BC Parks group camping page states that fees apply for a minimum of 15 adults, making this a group-only facility not suited to the typical individual touring cyclist.
concerns: This OSM record represents a group campsite specifically (minimum 15-adult fee applies per BC Parks group camping policy), not a standard campsite open to individual touring cyclists.
No address, phone, or email present in OSM record.
Website covers all of Goldstream Park rather than this specific group site; amenity details for the Prospector (Upper) Site cannot be confirmed individually.
Food and shelter amenities noted on the website are park-wide, not confirmed to be adjacent to or accessible from this specific group site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a designated group campsite: BC Parks group camping policy charges a minimum fee for 15 adults, making it unsuitable for individual or small-group touring cyclists. It could be appropriate for organised cycling clubs or tour groups, but requires human review to determine whether it meets WWC directory criteria.
enrichment_extras.notes: Goldstream Park also contains standard frontcountry campsites which may be more appropriate for the WWC directory than this group-only facility. A separate OSM record for the general campground, if it exists, should be evaluated alongside this one.
